products.name: HVAC Technician Social Media Templates
products.description:
30 days of HVAC content that doesn't sound like an ad. Every post is written from inside the trade: why short-cycling is quietly killing compressors, what a $99 tune-up bait offer really costs the customer, when a capacitor is a safety issue and not an upsell, and the seasonal checks homeowners forget until it's 100°F outside.

Each day gives you a hook, a caption, and a posting idea — drop in your company name and go. Built for the tech who'd rather be on a roof than writing captions.

Instant ZIP download — one month of posts, ready to schedule.

products.name: Roofing Contractor Spreadsheet Template
products.description:
Quote by the square, not by the gut feeling. This multi-tab workbook takes a roofing job from measurement to margin: material takeoff with waste factor, labor by square or crew-day, overhead and dumpster lines that actually get included, and a final quote sheet you can hand a homeowner with confidence.

A cash-flow tab shows what a job does to your month, not just your invoice — so you know which jobs to take and which to politely pass on.

Instant XLSX download — works in Excel and Google Sheets.

products.name: Appliance Repair Checklist Template
products.description:
The difference between a callback and a five-star review is paperwork. This one-page service checklist walks the diagnostic in the order real repairs happen: symptom intake, model and serial capture, the tests you ran, parts replaced, and the readings that prove the fix.

A built-in warranty slip means a callback becomes a documented service call — not an argument about what was and wasn't covered. The homeowner signs the finish line.

Instant PDF download — print a stack for the van.

products.name: Air Duct Cleaning Social Media Templates
products.description:
30 days of air-duct content your customers will actually stop scrolling for. The posts are built around what sells this service: before-and-after duct-cam footage hooks, filter schedules that make sense for real households (pets, kids, allergies), the dryer-vent fire-safety angle, and honest answers to "is duct cleaning a scam?"

Every day gives you a hook, a caption, and a visual idea. Add your company name and service area, schedule the month, done.

Instant ZIP download.

products.name: Mold Inspector / Remediator Spreadsheet Template
products.description:
Mold jobs get contested. This workbook documents the job AND protects the margin: containment class and PPE line items, HEPA/air-scrubber runtime costs, disposal bagging, moisture-source documentation fields, and a remediation cost sheet that holds up when an adjuster reads it.

A summary tab turns the technicals into a quote a property manager can approve without calling you twice — and the paper trail is the kind that wins disputes.

Instant XLSX download — Excel and Google Sheets compatible.

products.name: Home Energy Auditor Spreadsheet Template
products.description:
Turn a blower-door visit into a yes. This workbook translates your findings into homeowner language: the bill baseline they recognize, a savings estimate per improvement, and a payback period for each line — insulation, air sealing, HVAC, appliances — ranked by what pays back first.

The summary tab makes the report feel like a plan instead of a lecture, and the structured numbers keep your recommendations defensible when someone pushes back.

Instant XLSX download — Excel and Google Sheets compatible.

products.name: Beekeeping / Apiary Social Media Templates
products.description:
30 days of beekeeping content, from someone who knows what a smoker is. The month covers what your audience actually asks: honey harvest teasers, swarm-season alerts that get shared, first-hive buyer FAQs, and hive-check Reels scripts with shot lists — including what to film during an inspection and what to leave alone.

Each day: a hook, a caption, and a visual idea. Add your honey varieties, your prices, your market dates, and post.

Instant ZIP download — a month of content in one evening.
